title: SwimPacing: physics-based fatigue models of 200 freestyle pacing, tested against meet results under a pre-registered plan
description: Model code, pre-registered validation plan, calibration and held-out evaluation scripts, figures and paper source. Real race data is not included; the pseudonymous race table is deposited separately at Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/9N3Y2S (CC0 1.0).
